sections.title: Printing and checking internship entries
sections.what: Loads the starter internship list, looks for duplicate Microsoft entries, and prints a fixed summary of the edit, delete, storage and calendar checks. The summary is typed text, so it does not prove those features work.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The summary suggests it was written to record recent work on the internship edit and delete feature.
sections.watch_out: The PASSED lines print no matter what happens, so a clean-looking result from this script proves nothing.

summary: A quick script that prints the starter internship list and a summary of edit, delete, storage and calendar checks, but those checks are written as fixed text rather than actually tested.
purpose: Give a printed status of the internship edit and delete work, and look for duplicate Microsoft entries in the starter list.
why: Likely reason: written to show progress on the internship edit and delete feature. Reason not stated in the code beyond that.
how: 1. Prints the count and each entry in the starter internship list. 2. Finds entries whose company name contains Microsoft. 3. If there is more than one, builds a shorter list that keeps only the first, but never saves it. 4. Prints a fixed summary saying four checks passed.
inputs: The starter internship list from the initial data file. No user input.
outputs: Console text only. Nothing in the app or the database changes.
risks: The PASSED lines are typed in advance, so the printed result can say pass even when the feature is broken. Duplicate removal is only printed, never applied.
debug: If the summary looks wrong, test the real features in the app instead of trusting this script. Check the starter list in the initial data file for duplicate entries. Run the script from the project folder so the relative import paths work.
